d: In this video, Firstpost takes a look at the latest social media blunder by the Pakistan Air Force. To mark the birth anniversary of poet and philosopher Allama Iqbal, the force shared an image of a rocket launch on X. But eagle-eyed users quickly spotted that the picture was actually from a SpaceX Falcon 9 launch. Even more embarrassing, the original Falcon 9 label was still visible in the image. The post soon became meme material, with social media users mocking the apparent mix-up. What was meant to be a tribute turned into an internet roast! Hem Kaur Saroya brings you the details on…
